subject: Red Team SOW: deliverables, evidence handling, and timelines
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir@spadesec.com>
Date: 2027-06-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial ask — annual red team (scope + evidence handling)

Team —

We need to lock down our annual red team engagement for FY28. Key constraints:
- Target window: Aug 16–Sep 3 (end of quarter focused testing)
- Deliverables: targeted attack emulation, executive summary, full technical findings with reproducible evidence, and a separate remediation sprint support ticket queue
- Evidence handling: we must retain raw artifacts (pcap/log extracts/PoC) for 90 days in our tenant, and any copies held by the vendor must be deleted after acceptance unless we sign a longer retention agreement
- Budget: pref margin for fixed-price option ~ $120k–150k — negotiating with procurement.

Attached is the proposed scope workbook (redteam_scope_v1.xlsx) — please review gaps. Samir, can Spade confirm they can meet the 90-day evidence retention + deletion requirement and provide a redlined SOW with fixed-price and time-and-materials options? Also include a high-level timeline and whether blackbox or credentialed phases are recommended for our environment (we have dedicated Dedicated clusters and several private deployments).

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0143

Attachment: redteam_scope_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Samir Gupta <samir@spadesec.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-06-09T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — annual red team (scope + evidence handling)

Mina — thanks for the clear brief. High-level answers up front and a POA below. We can meet the 90-day evidence retention requirement and support deletion-of-copies on customer sign-off. We store artifacts encrypted by default and can provide a one-time transfer into your secure bucket; vendor-held copies will be scheduled for secure deletion 7 days after you mark artifacts accepted.

Options we propose (estimate ranges):
1) Fixed-price comprehensive red team — $138,000 — includes 3-week engagement, 2 testers + 1 ops support, executive + technical reports, 2 follow-up remediation checks within 60 days.
2) Phased + T&M — $95,000 base for scoped discovery + day-rate for exploitation (good if you want to limit scope).
3) Purple-team variant (hands-on remediation support onsite/remote) — $165,000.

Timeline: we can start Aug 16, field work Aug 16–Sept 3, draft report Sept 10, final report & artifacts Sept 17.

Attached: spade-draft-sow-v1.docx (initial SOW). I included a section (7.2) describing our artifact handling and deletion checklist; happy to redline to your language.

Samir Gupta
Director, Assessments — Spade Security
samir@spadesec.com
+1 (206) 555-0199

Attachment: spade-draft-sow-v1.docx (Word)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-06-10T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — annual red team (scope + evidence handling)

Mina / team —

Quick procurement note: if we pursue the fixed-price option, procurement will need:
- a clean SOW with acceptance criteria (we should define what "accepted artifacts" means — e.g., reproducible PoCs plus an evidence index),
- a DocuSign-ready SOW and vendor W9/contracting paperwork, and
- confirmation of insurer limits (vendor cyber liability minimum $5M).

Also: can Spade confirm whether screenshots/PoCs containing production customer data will be redacted prior to delivery? Our legal team will not want raw customer data in emailed artifacts.

To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir@spadesec.com>
Date: 2027-06-10T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — annual red team (scope + evidence handling)

Thanks — good points. A few clarifications and asks before we ask procurement to push a PO: 
- Acceptance criteria: artifacts accepted = PoC that reproduces an issue in our environment + an artifacts index (hashes + time window + data source). We will not accept customer-identifiable payloads in raw form — vendor to provide redacted PoCs and an incident-safe bundle for technical teams.
- Insurance: Samir, please confirm your cyber liability coverage and send a cert of insurance if available.
- DocuSign: Karthik, once Samir sends a redlined SOW with fixed-price terms, please prepare the DocuSign flow.

Decision preference: go with the fixed-price comprehensive red team ($138k) if Spade will incorporate our artifact deletion clause and provide the COI. If they cannot meet the deletion timeline, we will consider the phased option.

Thanks —
Mina

Subject: Re: Initial ask — annual red team (scope + evidence handling) — updated SOW + signature link

Mina / Karthik / team —

Attached is a redlined SOW (spade-draft-sow-v2.docx) reflecting:
- explicit artifact acceptance language and a 7-day deletion-after-acceptance schedule for vendor copies,
- a clause that all customer-identifiable data in PoCs will be redacted,
- fixed-price comprehensive option at $137,500 (we tightened scope assumptions), and
- updated timeline matching the Aug 16 start.

Also included: a COI and our cyber liability note (we carry $6M). Signing link: https://app.docusign.com/samples/RedTeam-SOW-48392 — please let me know the signatory and procurement contact and we can route it for signature today.

Samir
